status: Sensor acquisition and native depth conversion tested; Kimera execution not yet tested

initial_motion_recording_limitations.note: Motion bag has recorder-side highfreq loss and one IMU gap. Use QoS override for subsequent acquisition. User only performed short movement and rotations; endpoint displacement is not an accuracy/drift measurement.

limitations: Positive depth includes neighboring-pixel fill and nearest-neighbor enlargement; it is not independent measured coverage or validated accuracy.
Output frame_id is lidar while pixels encode camera optical depth; RGB frame_id is empty. Fix frames in adapter.
Converter discards per-point confidence and offset_time when converting to PointXYZ; assess filtering, occlusion and motion compensation before VIO use.
Depth timing measured from device headers. Approximately 1.685 ms RGB/cloud offset does not establish absolute sensor synchronization accuracy.

route_recommendation.first: Verify offline RGB-D+IMU Kimera frontend with calibrated rectified RGB, registered metric depth, checked camera-IMU extrinsics and consistent timestamps. Use Odin odometry as reference, not ground truth.
route_recommendation.fallback: If the original frontend cannot initialize or track reliably, integrate Odin odometry through a custom frontend adapter supplying keyframe descriptors, depth-supported geometric verification, pose graph and mesh inputs.
remaining: ROS 2 Humble sensor streams must be converted or bridged into the ROS 1 Kimera environment.
This test has no ground truth, long trajectory or second device; it does not validate absolute accuracy, inter-robot loop closures or distributed communication.

driver_shutdown_issue.when: After SIGINT, USB cancellation and sdk deinit complete; all recordings already stopped and flushed.
driver_shutdown_issue.impact: Driver shutdown stability issue remains unresolved; no equivalent error was observed during acquisition. Do not infer a firmware/SDK version mismatch cause without further debugging.
